Metadata.title: Professional Portfolio | Jorge Doicela
Metadata.description: Interactive portfolio of Jorge Doicela featuring virtual SSH terminal, cloud architecture, software projects, and AI/Cybersecurity background.

About.title: About Me
About.p1: Software developer based in Quito, Ecuador, guided by Christian values. Passionate about web engineering, native cross-platform applications, and server management (on-premise and cloud), focusing on comprehensive solutions, scalable architectures, security, and Infrastructure as Code (IaC).
About.p2: My experience covers Full-Stack development using technologies such as React, Next.js, NestJS, Laravel / Blade, and .NET, programming languages including PHP, C#, Python, C, and C++, as well as relational (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and non-relational (MongoDB) databases. I integrate DevSecOps practices and secure-by-design principles throughout the entire development lifecycle.

Terminal.title: Interactive Web Console

Terminal.mobileNotice: Interactive console is optimized for physical desktop keyboards.
Terminal.mobileBannerDesc: The interactive console utilizes commands, ANSI sequences, and keyboard shortcuts suited for desktop devices.
Terminal.matrixCloseHint: Click or press any key to exit Matrix
Terminal.matrixActiveBanner: MATRIX MODE ACTIVE • CLICK OR PRESS ANY KEY TO EXIT

SandboxTerminal.readyDescVps: Connect to a real live Linux console running on my Amazon Web Services (AWS) server. Explore system commands and see how it responds in real-time in a safe environment.
SandboxTerminal.readyDescTunnel: Connect directly to my private physical server through an encrypted secure tunnel. A live demonstration of hybrid architecture linking the web with local high-performance hardware.
SandboxTerminal.sessionReplacedNotice: Terminal was transferred to another window

SandboxWakeRequest.serverOfflineDesc: This console runs on a physical machine in my lab for advanced development, research, and testing. To optimize power consumption when not in active use, it remains powered off. You can notify me here and I will connect it shortly.
SandboxWakeRequest.requestWakePrompt: Click the button to notify me. I will receive an instant alert to turn on the machine and grant you access.
SandboxWakeRequest.submitErrorFallback: Could not submit the request. Please try again later.
SandboxWakeRequest.successDesc: I have successfully received your notification. As soon as I am available, I will power on the machine so you can test the terminal. You can keep this window open or return later.
SandboxWakeRequest.retryFailedDesc: The server is not yet available. I will connect it as soon as possible; you can keep this window open or return later.

SandboxSecurityModal.concurrencyTitle: You already have an active terminal in another window
SandboxSecurityModal.concurrencyDesc: To ensure fair usage and maintain sandbox integrity (1 active session per user), multiple simultaneous consoles are not permitted.
SandboxSecurityModal.replacedTitle: Terminal control switched to another window
SandboxSecurityModal.replacedDesc: The terminal was started or transferred to another tab in your browser. This session has been paused to maintain exclusive control in the active window.
SandboxSecurityModal.cooldownDesc: Due to security and isolation policies, please wait a moment while the terminal environment initializes.
SandboxSecurityModal.rateLimitDesc: You have reached the limit of 8 sessions per hour to protect the server from overload. You may enter again in the next hour window.
SandboxSecurityModal.blockedDesc: Access from this address has been temporarily blocked due to repeated requests. You can retry in a few minutes.
